import ast
from collections import Counter
import difflib
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import symtable
import sys

main = Path('/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/LogAnalysisSkill')
sys.path.insert(0,str(main/'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools'))
import terminal_scan as S
import terminal_registry as R
from terminal_predicates import canonical_hash, check_frozen_hashes, load_json

out = main/'docs/clang-fix-campaign/dev_memory/stage14_p49_terminal_batch/a0-evidence/part3/erratum6'
if sys.argv[1] == 'intake':
    old = subprocess.check_output(['git','show','5d61715:'+S.RULES],cwd=main)
    new = (main/S.RULES).read_bytes()
    assert S.sha256(old) == '1c35df1cd9aeafc5511aefaa3bdd468b785af665205319d92cc6d30350be6939'
    assert S.sha256(new) == S.RULES_SHA
    a,b = old.splitlines(keepends=True),new.splitlines(keepends=True)
    changes = [x for x in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None,a,b,autojunk=False).get_opcodes() if x[0]!='equal']
    assert len(changes)==2 and all(x[0]=='insert' for x in changes),changes
    assert changes[0][1]==8 and changes[1][1]==len(a),changes
    diff = subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--unified=3','--',S.RULES],cwd=main)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(diff)
    sys.stdout.flush()
    print('OLD_SHA256='+S.sha256(old))
    print('NEW_SHA256='+S.sha256(new))
    print(f'APPEND_ONLY=PASS additions={len(b)-len(a)} deletions=0 insert_blocks=2')
elif sys.argv[1] == 'registry':
    domain = R.authority(main)
    mapping = R.required_from_authority(main)
    registry = [{'branch':b,'detector_owner':o} for b,o in sorted(domain.items())]
    # Artificial projection fixtures only, not fabricated detector-control passes.
    controls = [{'branch':b,'detector_owner':o,'polarity':p}
                for b,o in R.ENTRY_OWNERS.items() for p in ('POSITIVE','NEAR_MISS')]
    green = R.reconcile_entry(main,registry,controls)
    print('ARTIFICIAL_ENTRY_PROJECTION_NORMAL=GREEN pairs='+str(len(green)))
    bad = [row for row in registry if row['branch']!='entry.binary_record']
    try:
        R.reconcile_entry(main,bad,controls)
    except S.ScanError as exc:
        assert str(exc).startswith('ENTRY_THREE_WAY:')
        print('ARTIFICIAL_DROP_ENTRY_BINARY_RECORD=RED_AS_EXPECTED '+str(exc))
    else:
        raise AssertionError('missing branch was accepted')
    for kind,branches in mapping.items():
        print(kind+' -> '+','.join(branches))
    S.write_atomic(out/'entry-kind-branches.json',{'rules_sha256':S.RULES_SHA,'required':mapping,
      'scope':'E4/E6 authority-derived mapping; no detector execution/completion claim'})
    print('NAMESPACES='+','.join(sorted(R.NAMESPACES)))
    print('BRANCH_COUNTS='+json.dumps(dict(Counter(b.split('.')[0] for b in domain)),sort_keys=True))
    print('E6_ENTRY_POSITIVE_NEAR_MISS_DETECTORS=NOT_RUN')
elif sys.argv[1] == 'scan04':
    manifest,files = S.fixed_inputs(Path.cwd(),main)
    path = 'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools/check_design_doc.py'
    source = files[path].decode()
    module = ast.parse(source,filename=path)
    function = next(n for n in module.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='_check_python_contracts')
    calls = [n for n in ast.walk(function) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) and n.func.id=='compile']
    assert len(calls)==1
    call = calls[0]
    symbols = symtable.symtable(source,path,'exec')
    scope = next(s for s in symbols.get_children() if s.get_name()==function.name)
    binding = scope.lookup('compile')
    assert binding.is_global() and binding.is_referenced() and not binding.is_assigned() and not binding.is_imported() and not binding.is_parameter()
    try:
        outer = symbols.lookup('compile')
    except KeyError:
        module_binding = None
    else:
        module_binding = {'assigned':outer.is_assigned(),'imported':outer.is_imported(),'parameter':outer.is_parameter()}
        assert not any(module_binding.values())
    # Assert no wildcard import could inject this name into the module scope.
    wildcards = [n for n in ast.walk(module) if isinstance(n,ast.ImportFrom) and any(a.name=='*' for a in n.names)]
    assert not wildcards
    text = (main/S.RULES).read_text()
    rows = [line for line in text.splitlines() if re.match(r'^\| `C[0-9]+[a-z]?` \|',line)]
    assert len(rows)==20
    # All table call predicates are closed; compile is not any listed callee.
    assert not any('`compile`' in row or '`builtins.compile`' in row for row in rows)
    matching=[]
    for row in rows:
        form = re.match(r'^\| `(C[0-9]+[a-z]?)`',row)[1]
        print('TABLE_ROW='+row)
        if form in {'C1','C4','C5a'}:
            reason='Call is not Import/ImportFrom'
        elif form.startswith('C7'):
            reason='PY_SOURCE is not non-Python input'
        elif form=='C5e':
            reason='builtin compile is not a sys.modules operation'
        else:
            reason='builtin compile is outside this closed callee family'
        print('REJECTION='+form+' | '+reason)
    record = {'path':path,'head':S.HEAD,'tree':S.TREE,'context':'.','entry_kind':'PY_SOURCE',
      'source_sha256':S.sha256(files[path]),'function':function.name,
      'span':{'line':call.lineno,'column':call.col_offset,'end_line':call.end_lineno,'end_column':call.end_col_offset},
      'source':ast.get_source_segment(source,call),'ast':ast.dump(call,include_attributes=False),
      'binding':{'is_global':binding.is_global(),'is_referenced':binding.is_referenced(),
                 'is_assigned':binding.is_assigned(),'is_imported':binding.is_imported(),'is_parameter':binding.is_parameter(),
                 'module_binding':module_binding,'wildcard_imports':len(wildcards)},
      'resolved_name':'builtins.compile','matching_atomic_forms':matching,'status':'UNKNOWN_CAPABILITY',
      'scope':'Targeted real-input preflight, not complete consumer engine or OBS claim'}
    S.write_atomic(out/'scan04.json',record)
    print(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    print('CONTEXT_COUNTS='+json.dumps(dict(Counter(e['context'] for e in manifest['entries'])),sort_keys=True))
    print('TRACKED_LEAVES='+str(len(manifest['entries'])))
    print('SCANNED_BINARY_RECORDS=NOT_RUN (input contains '+str(sum(e['entry_kind']=='BINARY' for e in manifest['entries']))+' BINARY entries)')
    print('FULL_CONSUMER_SCAN=NOT_RUN; FULL_FALLBACK_EDGES=N/A; FULL_AMBIGUITY=N/A; COMPLETION=ABSENT')
    print('SCAN-04 UNKNOWN_CAPABILITY: builtins.compile; matched_forms=0; STOP')
    raise SystemExit(1)
elif sys.argv[1] == 'immutable':
    p,e = load_json(S.DATA/'predicates.json'),load_json(S.DATA/'measurement_exemptions.json')
    check_frozen_hashes(p,e)
    print('predicates.json canonical='+canonical_hash(p))
    print('measurement_exemptions.json canonical='+canonical_hash(e))
    paths = ['tizen-*/scripts/','ci_triage/','release-v1.4.0/','docs/clang-fix-campaign/design.md',
             'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools/p49_terminal_data/predicates.json',
             'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools/p49_terminal_data/measurement_exemptions.json',
             'docs/clang-fix-campaign/dev_memory/stage14_p49_terminal_batch/a0-evidence/part2/',
             'docs/clang-fix-campaign/dev_memory/stage14_p49_terminal_batch/a0-evidence/part3/erratum5/']
    result = subprocess.run(['git','diff','--exit-code','HEAD','--',*paths],cwd=main)
    print('IMMUTABLE_AND_PRODUCTION_DIFF_EXIT='+str(result.returncode))
    assert result.returncode==0
else:
    raise SystemExit('unknown mode')
